title: Befriending John Wheeler at a New Jersey retirement community
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Befriending John Wheeler at a New Jersey retirement community, about unspecified (Wheeler's retirement years) at New Jersey; Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: New Jersey; Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton

tellings.quote: lived in New Jersey for a period of time worked for an entity that worked for the intelligence community and my wife wife was a nurse at a retire in a retirement community

plain: A man named Bob Maguire, who says he worked for a contractor serving US intelligence agencies, says he lived in New Jersey for a while and his wife was a nurse at a retirement community. He says that is how he came to befriend John Wheeler, a famous physicist linked to the Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton, in Wheeler's later years.
